newsitem.title: THAILAND: Nava Finance merges with CMIC, Thaimex.
newsitem.headline: Nava Finance merges with CMIC, Thaimex.

text.p: Nava Finance and Securities Plc, a leading Thai finance firm, said on Thursday it had signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to merge with CMIC Finance and Securities and Thaimex Finance and Securities Plc.
The company said in a statement the firms had decided to merge to seek a new banking licence.

To encourage consolidation among Thailand's 91 finance companies the Bank of Thailand announced on Wednesday that merging finance and securities companies would be eligible to apply for new banking licences.
After the merger, the combined Nava, CMIC and Thaimex entity would have total assets of 140 billion baht ($5.4 billion) and equity capital of 17 billion baht, the statement said.
A number of Thai finance and securities companies have been struggling to cope with declining asset quality and a more than 45 percent decline in the local stock market over the last year.
